## Database gate
- Database changes detected:
  - `backend/migrations/229_plugins.sql` adds `sub2api_plugin_installations`, `sub2api_plugin_bindings`, indexes, constraints, and plugin configuration storage.
  - `backend/migrations/230_plugin_artifacts.sql` adds nullable `artifact_data BYTEA` to `sub2api_plugin_installations`.
  - `backend/migrations/plugins_migration_test.go` verifies account schema isolation and idempotent plugin DDL expectations.
- No `backend/ent/schema/**` entity schema changes detected in the official delta.
- Production rollout requires backup and manual review before applying migrations 229 and 230; no production database mutation was executed.
